subject: Reopened: review CHANGES REQUIRED (flag opens card gate, delete+re-answer, mock questions) — decisions inside
body:
S08 review: CHANGES REQUIRED (3 high). Reviewer worktree + probes: /home/user/naadi/.claude/worktrees/review08/.tmp/ (probe.py, probe2.py, probe3.py). Lead decisions:
1. HIGH flag opens the flashcard gate: new migration changes the flashcards attempt-gate policy to require a graded attempt (chosen is not null and correct is not null); db test flag-then-card stays hidden. Flag-only rows stay allowed.
2. HIGH delete + re-answer: revoke DELETE on attempts AND on blocks from authenticated (account deletion still cascades). No client delete path is needed now; if a "remove past block" UI is wanted later it goes through the API and keeps attempts. Also revoke client SELECT on attempts.correct (column-level grant: select every column except correct) so mid-block correctness never leaks via PostgREST once S09 enables timed/exam; the API serves correctness only when allowed. Update test_rls.py, RLS coverage and live_check (item 8: assert INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE false and correct not selectable).
3. HIGH mock questions are exam-only (S09 runs them): exclude block is not null from _POOL/_GRADED (pool counts, block creation, weak-spot) and /blocks/single refuses them (404 with a clear code). db tests for all four. Note: seg07 is also stripping the mock answer-key table at import and dropping mock content from search.
4. Weak-spot test: fixed ids, deterministic; assert the cell set. Must not flake (run it 20x).
5. Builder legends on iPad WebKit: visually-hidden legend + visible heading inside the card (no float legend on a bordered fieldset). Screenshot all viewports.
6. Phone tab bar truncation: owned by seg07 (fixes it once for the shell). Not yours.
7. All listed literals to practice.* ui_copy; add 'practice' to noHardcodedCopy.test.ts roots once seg06 lands it.
9. Separate message for an empty pool (ui_copy).
10. Past-blocks loading/error states; /practice/question/$id reuses an open single-question block for that question instead of creating duplicates.
11. Hex literal → token in packages/ui tokens.css.
12. Covered by 2 and 3 (single refuses exam/mock; correct not client-readable).
Lab values: add a provenance note (ui_copy + sources row note) that the table is Naadi's own reference compiled from standard ranges.
Follow docs/REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md; local e2e = smoke set; full matrix from CI. E2E_PORT 7907 block. Claim the next Alembic revision on the ledger (S04/S12b may also add one).
